title: Preserve diagnostics handoff scroll during refresh

reason: Diagnostics owner-row handoff detail blocks are refreshed while the operator is reading them. Rewriting identical text rebuilds the scrollable detail DOM and snaps the box back to the top.

behavior_after: Refreshing with unchanged text leaves the existing detail DOM in place, preserving the operator's scroll position while still rendering changed text normally.
